name: Attack Shomenuchi
label: Attack · Shomenuchi — straight strike to the forehead with the hand-blade
description: Uke cuts straight down the centre line at Tori's forehead with the right hand-blade, stepping through with the right foot into a deep right hanmi; the cut stops a hand's width short of the forehead, the left hand at his own centre. In motion: left hanmi kamae at ma-ai, the right hand raised over the forehead (furikaburi), then the step and the cut. Uke walks in from about two metres into it.
